sampling_notes: Whole circular wafer must fit the shorter image axis; calculations use 2048 px with a 10% diameter margin.
5 pixels is a preliminary sampling criterion, not a universal detectability or optical MTF guarantee.
20 mm/2448 gives 8.1699 um/pixel. A 50 um feature spans 6.12 raw pixels but only 2.56 pixels after full-frame resizing to 1024.
Native 1024 px crops preserve raw sampling. Minimum lens MTF, depth of field, contrast and exposure need target tests.
Rectangular raster counts include empty corner tiles. Circle masks may reduce count only after coverage proof.
100 mm example requires 90 x 105.41 mm tile-center travel; 100 mm stage is insufficient for the Y example.
Cycle values are lower bounds from path/speed and assumed capture overhead; acceleration, communications, inference, focus and loading are excluded.
parts_maturity: All structural drawings are envelopes. No STEP/F3D produced; no joint, clearance or strength PASS claimed.
